title: 天球の鉄路、黄昏の終焉に
author: 竜胆 アルト

en.title: The Iron Tracks of the Celestial Sphere: Twilight's End
en.premise: In a world drowning in despair and stagnation, the legendary final train—said to carry the promise of "Tomorrow"—is the only hope left. Frontier librarian Elliot discovers a god’s hidden "Will" in an ancient tome, along with a golden ticket to board the train. To set the world’s time in motion again, he embarks on a journey through lost stations, gathering the memories of stars.

zh.title: 天球铁道：黄昏终焉
zh.premise: 在陷入绝望停滞的世界中，唯一被传说为携带“明日”的终极列车成为唯一的希望。边境图书管理员青年艾利奥特在古书中发现了神的“遗言”，并获得了一张乘坐列车的黄金车票。为了让世界的时间再次运转，他踏上旅程，寻找失落的车站，收集星辰的记忆。
